notes.title: Servers are back online! EDIT: SERVER ISSUES
notes.content:
[h1]EDIT: There is currently an issue with servers but solos seem to be working so please enjoy that while we work on fixing things. Sorry to disappoint, we will try our hardest to sort this as soon as we are able.  [/h1]

[h3][b]Aaand we’re back![/b] 

Hello everyone, the TABG servers are now back online! [/h3]

We’ve rewritten the network architecture which should help with the previous issues, we’re also utilizing more of EAC:s features for (hopefully) more safety. 

The report function has been re-implemented so that you can report cheaters in-game again. 

We’ve also decided to completely remove the leaderboards based on feedback from the community, as well as to make win-farming less of an incentive to cheat. 

As for community servers, they’re still in the works! But need some more testing before we roll them out, more news about that is coming soon. 

We know this rollout may not be perfect so let us know if you're experiencing server issues and report them to support@landfall.se 

[b]We’re hoping these changes will help with the issues the game has been having this summer, and we’re excited to start playing again with you all![/b]

notes.title: A message from the devs about the server issues
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello everyone! If you have tried to play TABG in the past couple of weeks you may have noticed that the servers have, for the most part, been down. [/b][/h3]

The servers are currently experiencing a DDOS attack and we’ve been spending a lot of time figuring out fixes together with the server providers. DDOS attacks are quite complicated to deal with and there is no quick fix, but we want you to know we are taking this very seriously.

[h3]Below are some commonly asked questions about what’s going on to hopefully shine some light on what we’re doing:
[/h3]
[b]Are you shutting down the servers for good?[/b]
No, we’re not planning on shutting down the TABG servers for good any time soon. We’re working hard to get them back up and running as normal. 

[b]Why don’t you get better DDOS protection?[/b]
As mentioned earlier there is no quick fix for DDOS issues. We’re looking into a couple of options but it seems they would require a redesign of how the networking works in TABG which in turn would mean months of work, and we want to get the servers back up and running asap. 

[b]When will you implement community servers?[/b]
Currently dealing with the DDOS attack is taking up all of the time we could spend on making community servers. We are still planning on implementing them, especially since they may help with these issues but it will take a little longer. 

[b]Will banning the DDOS attacker help?[/b]
No, we’ve banned accounts that may be associated with the attack but anti-cheat does not mean that they cannot attack the servers. 

[b]Why is someone doing this?[/b]
We don’t know, it feels really shitty to bring down the servers like this when the community is quite small, to begin with. It’s heartbreaking and we don’t really understand why one would like to ruin things for thousands of people.

Before we go we want to say a big thank you to the community members that have been helping us with information, it’s really great to see you all rally to help get the game back online. 

[b]We would also like to thank you for being patient as we’re looking into these issues, we hope to have it sorted soon. [/b]

notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! We just updated the game with a new anti-cheat, hopefully, it works well - otherwise, let us know![/b]

Late last year we were informed that EQU8 would now be exclusive to Splitgate and that they would shut down support for other games in February of 2023. We’ve been working to get an alternative up and running since. 

This patch also fixed one of the notorious dupe glitches! Thank you to the community members that helped us crack that one, we really appreciate you. 💗


[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new anti-cheat
[*] Fixed dupe glitch
[/list]

[h3]News[/h3]

As we talked about in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/823130/view/3095663598774085974?l=english)]this post [/url]no devs are actively working on TABG anymore due to the game not being able to support its own costs. We still intend on keeping the servers up and running for as long as possible.

[b]However we have also figured out a way to set up community-run servers! [/b]

Initially, we didn’t think this would be possible but in the work with the work we’ve done to change the anti-cheat, we figured out a way to do it.

This means that the more tech-savvy players will have the opportunity to set up their own servers to run TABG, we hope to get it up and running in the next coming weeks. We will keep you posted on when that update will go live!

[h3]The new update is out! Today’s update includes some well-awaited features like the results screen, reporting system, and balance! We're also adding a Battle Pass and some nice map changes.  [/h3]

[h2]Battle Pass[/h2]
We’re trying out a Battle Pass due to popular demand.

The Battle Pass comes with free and premium rewards. You level up the Battle Pass by playing and unlocking rewards along the way. 

In total there are 60 levels to keep you occupied for a while! We’re adding some new cool cosmetics, MC rewards, and a bunch of new [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@landfallgames/video/6989841333192068357?is_copy_url=0&is_from_webapp=v1&sender_device=pc&sender_web_id=6943232363762304518]G-mode music[/url]!

We have added a result screen after each match as well as leaderboards, you can now see how you compare to other players and who you’ve killed and who killed you.

We're also removing the MC gain from leveling since the Battle Pass free tier now gets you MC from just playing the game. 

[h2]A reporting system[/h2]
This update also adds a reporting system. You can report players in the pre-game from the escape menu OR through the new result screen. We hope this will catch cheaters that manage to get through the anti-cheat.

notes.title: Some information about what is going on with Beta nr 13
notes.content:
[h3]We should have known that if we had a Beta nr “13” things would go wrong. We have seen the feedback and the issues, we’re working on the bugs and hope to have them solved soon. [/h3]

[b]Here is a rundown of the bugs and some explanations behind changes that have been made. [/b]



[h2]Features that are coming very soon but wasn’t in this update:[/h2]

[b]“I want 3 Weapon slots and splitting weapon stacks back!”[/b]

The third weapon slot and splitting weapon stacks are both coming back and were always planned on coming back. 



[h2]Changes we will make:[/h2]

Remove auto equip for attachments. Maybe keep it on a separate key, or by holding down the pickup key.



[h2]Changes that would be cool:[/h2]

[b]"I would like the inventory to be auto-sorted. Like meds and stuff are always in the first slots no matter what.” [/b]

We have seen this feedback a lot and will look into it! 



[h2]Changes that are intended and will stay andy why:[/h2]

We know that it’s hard to embrace change, here’s some feedback we have gotten and our reasoning behind the changes. 

[b]"But what bothers me, even more, is the design decision to have only a certain number of general slots. I think this is the worst design decision of the whole update."
[/b]

Being able to carry infinite amounts of items removes interesting player choices, as well as often resulting in a confusing and messy experience of most players always carrying too much stuff, making it hard to find what you're looking for in your inventory.

Players being able to carry unlimited amounts of items also means that the map gets very empty of loot after the start of the game, putting respawning players at too much of a disadvantage. 

[b]"I don't like having only 3 grenade slots"[/b]

The grenade slots still have some missing functionality and some bugs causing it to be less of a smooth experience than what it will be like when finished.

The goal with the 3 grenade slots is to solve the issue where a player has too many grenades to effectively keep track of them and swap between them effectively.

Having to press the grenade button 10 times to get to the grenade you want was not an uncommon occurrence.

We will also change the way grenades spawn as loot. We intend to make grenades spawning rarer, but make grenades spawn in pairs of ~3 meaning you will have about as many grenades. Just fewer types of grenades at the same time.



[h2]Some of the bugs we are looking into[/h2]

[list]
[*] All the audio bugs: we’re looking into the reverb, collision sounds, loud sounds, missing sounds, audio cut out, volumes, distance, and echoes among other things. 
[*] Barrel attachment glitch.
[*] Dupe bug.
[*] Swapping weapon issue.
[*] Still being able to pick up items despite having a full inventory.
[*] Grenade hotkey issue.
[*] Stacking grenade bug.
[*] People shooting while downed.
[*] Inconsistency in dropping items.
[*] Everyone getting the same blessing bug. 
[*] Gun duping.
[*] Ghost gun bug.
[/list]

There is also a bunch more, you can always report bugs in the forums or by emailing support@landfall.se


[b]We hope this post explains our decisions and what we’re working on. Thank you for your patience as we’re fixing the bugs.  [/b]

Please keep bringing us feedback in the Steam forums, the discord, or by emailing info@landfall.se.

notes.title: The future of TABG
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927733/b09a7b53bfe07e5ccd98f1b0ec4c94cc99ca3bc8.png[/img]

In 2019 we posted [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791462449141/announcements/detail/1727596629128425663]this announcement[/url] talking about the future of the game and what was going on. A lot of things have happened since then and since about a year back we’re finally working on the game again. It's been amazing to see people participating in the betas and the player count going up once more. 

For those of you who haven’t been keeping up with the Betas here’s the rundown of what will be in the free to play update coming later this year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927733/c573faed5962c3257faf5125257835590621cb48.png[/img]

[h2]TABG Free to Play update will include the following features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Completely remade map with a bunch of new areas.
[*] A bunch of new weapons, attachments, and grenades.
[/list]

[h3]Blessings[/h3]
The game now has buffs called "blessings" that the players can find, these blessings improve the player's character in some way. 

[b]For example:[/b]
[list]
[*] More movement speed
[*] Extra air jumps
[*] Faster fire rate
[*] Your bullets light your opponent on fire if you shoot to the beat of a song
[*] You regain health when lying down
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]Curses:[/h3]
You can be brought back to life by your teammates if you die. You do however return to life with a "curse". These range from mild drawbacks in combat like slower bullets or a bigger body, to silly limitations like not being able to look to the left.

[h3]Limbo[/h3]
When you die early on in the game you get a chance to release by surviving a skydiving minigame where you need to avoid falling pillars and get to the end in time. Depending on how well you do in this minigame you either don't return at all, return with a curse, return normally or return with random blessings.

[h3]Levels[/h3]
The player now gathers XP when playing which allows the player to level up. Gaining levels lets the player choose a different color for their name, and will most likely also reward cosmetic items.

[h3]UI and UX redesign[/h3]
The game's UI has always been pretty clunky and hard to use for new players, we are working on completely redesigning from scratch.

[h3]Catchphrases[/h3]
Each player gets to select a sequence of 3 words that they can at any time announce when playing. The player can also select the voice that these words are said in, as well as change the pitch of the voice.

[h3]Performance, stability, and bug fixes[/h3]
The game has also gotten a lot of work put into fixing bugs, improving network stability, and improving performance as well as updating the anti-cheat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927733/4928963ff4e0d1d517ba784c86ffe68e7e3cd7e0.png[/img]

[h3]Brawl mode[/h3]
The Brawl mode is still coming to TABG but we have decided to postpone the implementation of the mode until sometime after the free to play update. When we relaunch the game it’s important to us that the player base isn’t divided more than necessary in order to ensure full matches. We still want the mode to be available further down the road! 

[h3]Classic TABG[/h3]
If you hate the changes and love classic TABG we will either have a server or beta branch available with the classic version. If you want to play it right now when we’re running a beta you can do so by using the beta code: PLAYTHEOGTABG

[b]If you have any questions or feedback please post it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/823130/discussions/]steam forums [/url]or by emailing us at info@landfall.se[/b]

notes.title: News on the F2P update, new cosmetics and the helmet of shame!
notes.content:
In November we posted a list of what we’re working on, you can find it here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/823130/announcements/detail/1700567065814770192
Our hope was to release the big update early this year but as it stands now we are not ready and we need our three programmers on Totally Accurate Battle Simulator.

For those who don’t know, TABG is a spoof of our main game Totally Accurate Battle Simulator. TABG was originally only meant to be an April Fools joke so that the Totally Accurate Battle Simulator players had something to do while they waited for release. We don’t want to keep them waiting any longer and to release Totally Accurate Battle Simulator we need all hands on deck. 

What does this mean? It means that we will not go F2P as soon as we hoped but we will further down the road. We’re not abandoning the game, we still want to bring in more players and finish the new brawl mode. We’re also looking into ways of getting help from other studios on the project but as it stands now we don’t know when the F2P update will be.

We never expected this game to have such an amazing dedicated player base, we want to do you justice but for that, we need some more time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927733/b262e8a51d306766b0b271a26ee46b4c65519ef8.jpg[/img]

As a consolation we’ve added some new cosmetics to play around with, we devs also promise to wear the new shame-helmet every time we play! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927733/ddae643f488c3840769056eb86e18e576b173fd0.jpg[/img]

[b]Please email us at info@landfall.se or post in the forums if you have any thoughts or questions regarding this announcement. We cannot answer in the comments under this post. [/b]

Remember to restart steam and verify the integrity of the game files to get the update.

[b]TDLR:[/b] We’ve added some new cosmetics as compensation for not going F2P in the near future.  We will eventually do so but currently, we are focusing on finishing TABS and need all hands on deck.

notes.title: Things we're working on!
notes.content:
[b]Hi! Thank you who participated in our first community test of the new brawl mode, we’re super happy with the feedback and are working on the necessary changes. We aim to have another test soon, stay tuned on social media/announcements![/b]

[b]We are also hoping on going free to play (F2P) in the future because of these reasons: [/b]

- It’s currently hard to find a match with fifty people as was intended, F2P will help bring in new people. 

- The server costs are very high and an F2P update will extend the lifetime of the game.

[b]
Don’t worry. We will make sure that the people who got the game before going free will have something unique and cool to make it worth their while. [/b]

[b]In order to go F2P we need to finish some major things, this is what we’re working on:[/b]

- Finishing the Brawl mode which currently will have three maps.

- Streaming: Behind the scenes, we’re working on a streaming tool that will optimize the game for better performance. This is a bit of a gigantic task but we believe it will be a major lift for the game. It will hopefully lead to less lag spikes, it will optimize the rendering of the world and decrease the workload of the CPU.

- Cosmetics: To be able to go F2P we need an in-game store for cosmetics, we’ve come some way with this but it needs more work to make sure it works correctly. 

[b]
These things need to be finished before we go F2P to ensure it goes correctly, we will not do so unless these things are in place. Thank you all for sticking with us for this long <3

Please keep questions to the forums as we cannot answer here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/823130/discussions[/b]

notes.title: The future of TABG - What we're working on
notes.content:
Hello everyone! For those who don’t know we’ve been back from vacation for a couple of weeks now and we are working hard on the game, this was originally posted in the forums a couple of weeks ago but I'll post it here as well for visibility. :) 

Here’s what we’re working on right now:

[b]Anti-cheat[/b] [UPDATE: The anti-cheat patch is now live and appears to have fixed the major cheating issues]
We’re implementing better anti-cheating measures that we hope will deal with the majority of the hacker issues the game is facing. Right now we’re testing the anti-cheat to make sure it works and won’t interfere with non-cheating players ability to play the game. 

[b]Content updates[/b]
These will take a while as we have some major things in the works. 
- A new close quarter game mode with its own map
- Two new areas added to the battle royale map
- More customization


We have seen your suggestions of going f2p in the forums and we’re looking into the possibility of doing so to try to make sure that there are enough players for you to get a game at all times. If we go down this route there need to be systems in place to handle server issues and an in-game store to keep the servers up. We are also looking into having a free weekend soon to bring in some more players. 

EDIT: If we do go f2p we will make sure that those who have paid for the game feel that they get something out of it.
